title: Credits on the Memory Care Account
content:
A credit reduces the amount owed on the memory care account under the Memory Care Residency Agreement. Credits carry a reason - billing error, move-out proration, program change proration, absence credit, entrance plan discount or respite conversion - and, except for a respite conversion credit, reference the charge they credit.

## Guidance

1. **Entrance plan discount.** While the resident holds an Entrance Fee Agreement in occupied status, each monthly rate charge receives an entrance plan discount credit of the care fee discount percentage of the agreement's plan, as set by the Entrance Fee Agreement terms. The credit references the charge and the agreement and is rounded to the cent half up. The discount applies because the memory care rate is a care rate; add-ons and fees are not discounted.
2. **Respite conversion credit.** A respite conversion credit is posted only as the consequence of a converted Larkspur respite stay under a Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, for the amount the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement terms fix, and it carries that respite stay.
3. **Billing error.** A charge posted in error is corrected only by a billing error credit referencing that exact charge, never exceeding it.
4. **One of each reason per charge.** Each charge entry receives at most one credit of each reason, so at most one billing error credit and at most one entrance plan discount credit.

## Entrance plan discount: what is discounted

| Charge on the memory care account | Entrance plan discount credit while an Entrance Fee Agreement is occupied |
|---|---|
| Monthly rate charge, full month | Yes |
| Monthly rate charge, prorated span | Yes |
| Care add-on or other fee | No |
| Community fee | No |

## Worked figures (hypothetical percentage and charges)

With a hypothetical care fee discount percentage of 10 percent: a monthly rate charge of 7200.00 receives a credit of 720.00; a prorated monthly rate charge of 4560.00 receives 456.00; an insulin administration add-on receives none. A billing error credit against a charge of 395.00 may be at most 395.00.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a second billing error credit be posted against the same charge?** No; a charge entry receives at most one credit of each reason.

**Does the entrance plan discount continue once the Entrance Fee Agreement is no longer occupied?** The discount is granted while the agreement is in occupied status.
